about: Heat-set insert kinds and the pocket each one needs, from the mouth down: melt relief, lead-in, hole. Depths are from the relief floor; the insert ends flush with it. "band" is the range of diameters that says "this hole is meant for that insert": a hole whose smallest diameter is in a band and that does not have the profile of its row is a wrong pocket (inserts.pocket_shape). The band of a measured kind is wide enough to catch every form that failed; the band of a recorded kind is narrow, round its recorded hole, so that dowel and magnet holes stay out of it. "profile" says how far a row can be trusted: measured (a coupon in the named material), derived (computed from a measured row, never printed) or recorded (numbers that were in use and never measured: do not cut new pockets from them). A recorded row is a straight hole (lead-in depth 0.0): it keeps the band, so that such a pocket is seen and measured, and it is not a profile a pocket can match. Kinds with the same diameters are told apart by depth and by the insert ref on their axis.
melt_room_about: measured with the M3x4x5 row: hole depth = insert length + 2.5 below the relief floor, room for the displaced plastic and the screw tip
hole_short_by_relief_about: false: a pocket ends at its row's hole depth below the relief floor, as the row was measured. true would let a pocket WITH a melt relief end one relief depth short of that depth and still be the pocket of its row: a decision nobody measured on a print, so it is not the default. Why the question comes up: tools/fusion/insert_pockets.py relief() cuts the relief and moves the lead-in down by the relief depth into a pocket that exists, and leaves the narrow hole as it is, so every pocket that got its relief later is hole depth minus relief depth deep below the relief floor (M3x4x5: 6.5 - 0.54 = 5.96, 1.96 of room under the insert instead of the 2.5 the row was measured with). With false each such pocket is a row of inserts.pocket_shape that says so; the owner decides the group once in the triage list (tolerate, or the rule is wrong for his project), or deepens the holes. A pocket without a relief gets no such allowance either way.
